status_definitions.Passed: Named local evidence meaningfully exercises the stated local scope. It is not a live/physical/deployment pass.
status_definitions.Partial: Only part of the requirement is proven; other functional, platform or integration paths remain unverified.
status_definitions.Not implemented: Feature absent from the reviewed implementation.
status_definitions.Not verified: Insufficient current executed evidence for this requirement.
status_definitions.Blocked: Specific platform/access/signing blocker prevents fulfillment in this environment.
status_definitions.Failed: At least one mapped current test reports a failure, including cleanup or readiness failures. In an interrupted infrastructure run this does not by itself isolate a product defect. Historical before-fix results and zero-assertion startup aborts are recorded separately.

final_js.composition: The four current server-dependent backend reruns replace their earlier results, and new permission cases are added once. Other backend, Firestore and client/bridge results retain their original execution provenance and matching inputs.
